violations.description: General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. Black tape was placed on the handles of the left and right doors of the reach in cooler.

General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Material of nonfood contact surface was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. Black tape was put in place of a broken handle on the right door of the reach in cooler by the walk in door.
